column3: “In death” is supplied; the beds are not expressly mentioned.
“Adulterers and prostitutes” makes the parents plural.
“Your bed” supplies an object for uncovering; “their nakedness” interprets “a hand.”
“Renewal of your strength” interprets “the life of your hand.”
“Of idols” identifies what has been collected.
“Praise” interprets the fruit of lips; “them” replaces singular “him.”
